title: Chapter 602
paragraphs: Chapter 602
Episode 156. Purifying Chaos (6)
It was as if a surprised cat sprang up like an arrow. But of course, its body was too massive compared to a cat.
Koong-!
As it fell backward, a vibration erupted across the training ground. Jin took a step back from the minor shockwave that ensued.
'Indeed, it reacts sensitively to spirit power.'
Yona, Amela, Gleeck, and so on. Almost all of the chaos he had encountered greatly feared Solderet's power, or held deep grudges against it.
The first chaos derived from Heluram was no different. It was catching its breath, eyes wide as if about to pop out any moment.
Though it wasn't visible, it felt as if it were sweating profusely, like after a rain shower.
"Oh, this time Brother Jin has taken the lead from the start?"
"Brother! Well done, keep pressing on, give it a blow!"
The Celestials who came to watch (some even prepared snacks and drinks in the spectator's seat) clenched their fists and shouted. Vahn, as before, maintained a five-step distance from Jin.
However, it wasn't easy for Jin to close the gap again.
Unlike before when it was just feigning ignorance or watching out for Vahn, the Chaos, having calmed its startled heart, was clearly exuding hostility towards Jin.
His legs refused to move, as if they were under the weight of Tess's power, under heavy pressure.
It wasn't a psychological problem such as being filled with fear or losing fighting spirit.
Jin's legs were stiffened purely due to the tangible pressure formed by its hostility.
"How dare you."
With a single word muttered quietly by Vahn, Chaos immediately withdrew its hostility.
Instead, it complained about the unfairness in its tremendously gloomy voice, unique to the 'distinguished chaos'.
[Keiiing... mew.]
The voice of distinguished chaos has a kind of penetrative power that digs into human psyche.
The reason why beings like Mashinseok or Gleeck break the human will with mere howls is not just because they are strong.
The first chaos that escaped from Jin was the same. Even Jin felt pity for a moment at its whining sound.
'Am I crazy, feeling sorry? What am I thinking.'
Especially, Jin had no choice but to be particularly sensitive to its voice.
Chaos wasn't entirely composed of chaos.
Jin's energy. It naturally came to resemble a part of Jin's psyche as it acquired his energy.
In other words, there existed a sort of internal connection between him and the creature, allowing them to feel each other's emotions more vividly.
Therefore, as Jin moved forward to strike it again, he had to compose himself every moment. It wasn't pitiful at all, it was just an evil entity that had to be eliminated.
[Kyung, Keiii, Kying!]
"What do you want?"
[Kyiiing!]
"You're noisy. Shut your mouth and receive Brother Jin's sword."
On the other hand, Chaos considered this situation unfair. That human was trying to annihilate it, and Vahn was firmly backing him up, which was infuriating.
Even when it appealed to Vahn, all it received was a cold and oppressive response.
In fact, Chaos was willing to let it slide as long as Jin didn't harm it.
It was supposed to consume Jin and become 'one', but since they were already separated, it thought they could each live their own lives.
As the creature, it didn't even recognize that it had stolen Jin's power. It felt like it was its original possession.
Chaos began to distance itself from Jin, and Jin was on the chase.
And the fleeing Chaos wondered why Jin 'had spirit power'.
Jin was contemplating how to deal with that shallow and cunning creature.
'It's clear that the spirit power is threatening to it, but my body isn't cooperating enough to properly unfold the spirit sword.'
Eudeuk!

Jin, grinding his teeth. He couldn't properly strengthen his body with just spirit power. Although he had released the spirit power armor (he couldn't use Mul-ta's rune due to lack of mana), opening Bradamante was too much.
'Do I need to learn how to strengthen my body with spirit power? I don't know how much time that would take. If I primarily use spirit power, my training might go wrong when I regain aura.'
He never thought he would miss the aura that used to fill his veins so much. It was strange to even imagine filling the empty Danjeon and aura operation organs with spirit power instead.
"Uheum."
"At first it looked like Brother Jin had the upper hand, but now, I'm not sure if this can even be called a fight?"
"Brother Jin, it's such a pity. The brother who used to be so strong…"
"Ehehei, don't talk negatively like that. If you say such things, it feels like Brother Jin will never become strong again."
However, as time passed, Jin and Vahn were understanding this battle in a completely different dimension from others in the training ground.
'It's just as the Tushin Brothers said. It's still difficult to close the gap with it, but I can feel the powers that the Tushin Brothers mentioned, bit by bit.'
Like light hidden in thick fog, Jin's energy taken by Chaos was faintly glowing from various parts of its body.
Only Jin could see that, and he felt like it would rush towards him like a wave if he just grabbed it.

'It's dangerous for the Tushin Brothers to break the damn barrier for me. Even if it's not a direct hit, just hitting the barrier could cause problems with the energy it has that is mine. The Tushin Brothers must be keeping quiet for the same reason.'
It was as Jin thought.
However, not only that, Vahn was maintaining a distance of five steps from Jin, and also feeling a strange sensation.
'Is there some kind of resonance happening between Brother Jin and me...?'
The heart of light of the Myungwang clan and the power contained within could amplify in response to Vahn's power.
That's why the hearts of light of the two kings present in the Tushin War shone unusually when Jin first found Lafrarosa. The Myungwang clan called this phenomenon 'Tushin Resonance'.
Jin, who also had a heart of light, could resonate in the same way, but not now.
'At present, there wouldn't even be the minimum amount of energy left in Brother Jin's heart of light for resonance... why?'
As if something had come to mind, Vahn grabbed Jin's shoulder.
"Tushin Brother?"
"Brother Jin, don't you feel it?"
"What... Huh?"
Jin stopped in his tracks. Thanks to Vahn strengthening the bond of Tushin Resonance, now Jin could feel the same sensation as her.
'The power of Tushin Brother feels like it's going to connect directly to me...!'
It was an unfamiliar sensation to Jin too. However, it was not the first time.
Bluebird Archipelago, Island 32.
-(My brother, whom I want to kill, Paitel.)
-(How dare you think of descending in my grave...)
A similar thing had happened in the Bluebird Archipelago where he first killed Joshua's clone.
That day, the remnant thoughts of the thunder god 'Gram' remaining in Sigmund resonated with the sword, enhancing his aura. That memory came to mind.
A similar sensation was enveloping Jin.
"It seems like I might be able to help Brother Jin."
Goooooo...!
Suddenly, it was as if the sky had opened, or they were submerged in a sea wave.
The entire training ground was filled with bluish aura. It was a phenomenon that occurred when Vahn unleashed her power.
[Kek, Kek!?]

Chaos mistakenly thought that Vahn had changed her mind and was going to harm it, regardless of whether Jin was wrong or not, but that wasn't the case. If it had been, Chaos would have been torn to shreds by the energy that Vahn had unleashed.
The reason Vahn unleashed her energy was to send it to Jin.
As if a god was granting a power to a human.
Vahn had never lent her power to someone else like this before, but she was sure. She believed that Jin could accept this power.
Chaos was still unable to understand the situation, cringing in fear, and in the meantime.
Jin shivered at the feeling of 'being reborn'.
Fzzzzt-!
Like spreading flames, a light was blazing from Jin's chest. The Heart of Light started to flash again with blue aura.
The bluish aura also lingered over the black blade of the soaked Bradamante.
His body, which had only felt as heavy as a rock, became much lighter, and it seemed like he could cut through the protection of Chaos anytime.
'Now, I can really fight.'
As to how the two resonated, how this new method of 'inheritance' would be cultivated in the future, and what problems exist in the resonance.
These thoughts could wait until after the fight was over. After all, Jin wouldn't die or be crippled fighting Chaos.
"I was surprised when I found out I was on borrowed time a while ago. You should feel that too, Chaos. Now, you're the one on borrowed time."
Shaaaa-!
With just two leaps, he closed the distance to the protective barrier that had felt infinitely far away.
Jin swung his sword with eyes full of ecstasy, and Vahn again maintained a distance of five steps from Jin.
For Chaos, it was infuriating and worth jumping around.
[Kyaaaaaak!]
He was repelled by Chaos's roar once, but he did not faint as before.
'I can bear it somehow. It's not as ridiculous as last time.'
Of course, the power shown by Chaos was only a fraction. But now, for Jin, Chaos was no longer an insurmountable wall, but a target that could definitely be overcome by constantly confronting.

Bradamante cut a chunk of the creature's protective barrier. The creature, taken aback by Jin's sudden increase in power, was unable to restore the barrier immediately, and Jin was not the type to miss such an opportunity.

Jin, who had stepped into the protective barrier, targeted the creature's instep while dodging its reflexively swung front foot. On the instep, there was a clump of energy that originally belonged to Jin.
Before the creature could thrash about in earnest, Jin quickly threw himself towards the instep.

As he reached out to the energy like grabbing a fallen object, it felt as if he was biting into an incredibly sweet fruit after starving for several days. That sweetness seemed to awaken all his blood vessels in an instant!
He could feel the lost power pouring back in at once. The first power that Jin retrieved from the creature was about 10% of the aura.
The moment of joy was brief.
As soon as the power returned to his body, his consciousness faded abruptly as if a thread was cut.
However, the unconscious Jin wore a genuinely happy smile. Just like people who have reclaimed something precious.
